description: This file contains a class `AmazonAgentCoreConfig` which implements configuration and processing logic for interacting with AWS Bedrock's AgentCore model. It includes methods for constructing request URLs, signing requests with AWS SigV4 or bearer tokens, transforming requests and responses (including parsing JSON and SSE stream formats), handling streaming responses, and integrating with custom HTTP clients. The class is part of a larger framework for orchestrating LLM interactions, tailored specifically for AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

classes.name: AmazonAgentCoreConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for AWS Bedrock AgentCore interactions, providing methods for request URL construction, request signing, response parsing (JSON and SSE), streaming support, and environment validation tailored for AWS's AgentCore model.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns an empty list, indicating no OpenAI-compatible parameters are supported by AgentCore.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to AgentCore-specific parameters, currently returns optional_params unmodified.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full request URL for AgentCore, based on the model's ARN, optional endpoint parameters, and qualifiers.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Optional[bytes]] sign_request( self, headers: dict, optional_params: dict, request_data: dict, api_base: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, stream: Optional[bool] = None, fake_stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Signs the HTTP request either with a bearer token if api_key is provided, or with AWS SigV4 otherwise.

methods.description: Extracts the ARN string for the runtime from the model specification.

methods.name: str _extract_region_from_arn(self, arn: str)
methods.description: Extracts the AWS region component from the ARN string.

methods.name: str _get_runtime_session_id(self, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Returns existing runtimeSessionId or generates a new one with a UUID, ensuring it is at least 33 characters.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_runtime_user_id(self, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Retrieves the runtimeUserId from optional parameters if present.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares the payload for the AgentCore request, including setting headers for session and user IDs, and serializing the prompt.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] _extract_sse_json(self, line: str)
methods.description: Parses JSON data embedded in SSE data lines.

methods.name: Optional[AgentCoreUsage] _extract_usage_from_event(self, event_data: Dict)
methods.description: Extracts token usage information from event metadata if available.

methods.name: Optional[str] _extract_content_delta(self, event_data: Dict)
methods.description: Extracts text delta from contentBlockDelta event payload.

methods.name: str _extract_content_from_message(self, message: AgentCoreMessage)
methods.description: Concatenates text blocks from an AgentCore message object.

methods.name: Optional[Usage] _calculate_usage( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], content: str )
methods.description: Uses token counter utility to estimate tokens used in prompt and response.

methods.name: AgentCoreParsedResponse _parse_json_response(self, response_json: dict)
methods.description: Parses a JSON-formatted AgentCore response, extracting the content message.

methods.name: AgentCoreParsedResponse _get_parsed_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response )
methods.description: Selects the appropriate parsing method based on content type (JSON or SSE).

methods.name: AgentCoreParsedResponse _parse_sse_stream(self, response_text: str)
methods.description: Processes SSE stream text line-by-line to extract message content, usage, and final message.

methods.name: AgentCoreSSEStreamIterator get_streaming_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, )
methods.description: Creates a streaming iterator from the raw SSE response.

methods.name: CustomStreamWrapper get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper( self, model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, api_base: str, headers: dict, data: dict, messages: list, client: Optional[Union[HTTPHandler, "AsyncHTTPHandler"]] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, signed_json_body: Optional[bytes] = None, )

methods.description: Sets up an asynchronous custom stream wrapper for streaming responses.

methods.name: bool has_custom_stream_wrapper(self)

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )

methods.description: Indicates that this model configuration should provide fake streaming responses.
